title: Engineering Governance Approver Authority Policy
description: Who may approve an exception or accept a risk, by severity (EXC-021 section 15). Roles and their holders are data, so leadership can change them without a code change. P0 is never approvable through this flow (EXC-021 section 8) and cannot appear here.

version.description: Version of this policy schema the file conforms to.

require_signed_approvals.description: When true, the CLI verifies every approved exception's GPG signature against the approver's key_fingerprint whenever this policy is applied, and an approval without a verified signature does not hold. Needs key_fingerprint on the holders. A policy consumed from the pinned governance baseline cannot be changed by the project that is assessed.

id.description: Stable role id. An exception's approver_role and a risk's acceptance_role name it.

severities.description: Severities this role may approve. EXC-021 gives a minimum authority per severity, so a role covers its own severity and every lower one. P0 is not allowed.

source_text.description: The row of the standard that defines the role, quoted verbatim. A test verifies it still exists.

holders.description: People who hold the role. Use the name UNASSIGNED as an explicit placeholder; it never counts as a holder.

key_fingerprint.description: Full fingerprint of the GPG key this holder signs approvals with (40 or 64 hex characters, spaces allowed). Used to authenticate a signed approval.

status.description: DRAFT roles are reported but confer no authority. Only APPROVED roles are enforced.
